# Anthony Baptiste Product Growth and GTM Portfolio

This is the recruiter-facing portfolio website for Anthony Baptiste. It is separate from any consulting website and is intended for recruiters, hiring managers, product teams, growth teams, GTM teams, product operations teams, product analytics teams, experimentation teams, operations teams, and applied AI teams.

Anthony Baptiste is currently employed and selectively open to full-time roles only.

## Positioning

Anthony Baptiste is a Chicago / Northern Illinois product, growth, and GTM candidate who uses experimentation analysis, customer and market research, KPI design, operations reporting, forecasting, stakeholder communication, and applied AI workflows to turn business questions into product decisions.

His work combines product experimentation, customer and market analysis, KPI strategy, operations visibility, SQL/Python analytics, applied AI research, forecasting, and business decision support.

## Core Skills

Product and growth: product discovery inputs, customer problems, growth loops, funnel analysis, conversion analysis, feature impact, prioritization support.
Experimentation and metrics: A/B testing, multivariate testing, Adobe Target, AB Tasty, KPI design, guardrail metrics, post-test storytelling.
GTM and customer insight: market research, competitor analysis, customer segments, positioning inputs, success criteria, stakeholder interviews.
Product operations: operations analytics, process visibility, dashboard requirements, stakeholder alignment, Salesforce reporting, decision workflows.
Data fluency: SQL, Python, Tableau, Power BI, Excel, pandas, PostgreSQL, dbt exposure.
Applied AI and research: LLM workflows, prompt structure, GPT simulations, Claude workflows, NLP, sentiment scoring, Streamlit.
